name: Zhewen Interactive Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhewen Interactive Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides intelligent marketing solutions in China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Internet Business and Computing Power Business. The company offers integrated marketing services and industry solutions, performance marketing field, internet marketing, digital cultural services, and computing power services.
